title: Backup console
idea: Backup console: Source coverage and restore points precede backup actions
audience: People who need to backup within a desktop surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic ledger layout through its backup priority and explicit commitment contract: Never call an unverified copy a recoverable backup
navigation: Backup console keeps the current backup context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Source coverage and restore points precede backup actions
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to backup; users need recoverable copies
composition.priority: Never call an unverified copy a recoverable backup

imagery.role: Support the actual backup context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep restore verification discoverable at narrow windows
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the backup console structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no backup content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Never call an unverified copy a recoverable backup
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized backup content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Never call an unverified copy a recoverable backup
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active backup context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
